description: Build a Textual-based terminal user interface that serves as a unified menu-driven application for all crypto accounting functionality - portfolio views, transaction recording, CSV imports, tax reporting, visualizations, and diagnostics
principles: Additive Only - TUI wraps existing API; no business logic changes, all CLI scripts preserved
Direct API Access - Screens call CryptoAccounts methods directly, no intermediate REST layer
Keyboard First - Every action reachable via keyboard shortcuts; mouse supported but not required
Guided Flows - New users can accomplish tasks without reading docs or knowing CLI arguments
Consistent Screens - Every screen follows the same compose/mount/load pattern
